parse.title: Enlightened Journey/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
==Walkthrough==
:'''Note''': This quest can be completed in two trips to [[Entrana]] if inventory space is managed well. Follow the guidance in each section to see what items are needed and when to return to a bank.

===Getting started===
{{Needed|3 Papyrus, unlit candle, ball of wool, sack of potatoes, red and yellow dyes, 10 silk, 8 empty sacks, bowl (obtainable during this section from the house just east of Auguste, up the ladder)}}
{{Checklist|
*Travel to Entrana (speak to monks on second most northern dock in Port Sarim) 
*Talk to [[Auguste]] on [[Entrana]] north of the Herblore shop (3 times) {{Chat option|1Yes! Sign me up.|1Umm, yes. What's your point?|1Yes.}}
*Use the papyrus with the ball of wool.
*Use the unlit candle on the [[balloon structure]].
*Talk to Auguste again.
*Talk to Auguste again with the two papyrus and a sack of potatoes in your inventory. {{Chat option|1Yes, I have them here.}}
*Go slightly south of [[Auguste]] and fill up the sacks with sand.
*Give Auguste a yellow dye, a red dye, ten silk, a bowl, and eight sandbags.
**A bowl spawns in the house east of Auguste on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}
}}

===The big balloon===
{{Needed|Tinderbox, 12 willow branches, 10 '''regular''' logs (axes cannot be taken to Entrana, obtain the logs before)|recommended=additional noted regular/oak/willow/yew/magic logs if you wish to unlock additional routes after the quest}}
{{Checklist|
*Leave [[Entrana]] to retrieve the remaining items. You may consider banking in [[Pest Control]], either using [[Minigame Teleport]] or returning to [[Port Sarim]] and travelling there and back via the ships.
**If you still require [[willow branches]], they can be purchased from the [[Grand Exchange]] or trimmed with secateurs by using them on the grown sapling given by Auguste or another [[Willow Tree (Farming)|willow tree]] you've grown. Do '''not''' clear the stump, or cut down the tree until all branches are obtained.
*Back on Entrana, use the branches on the balloon frame on the nearby platform.
*(Optional) Store any additional logs in the [[log storage]].
*Talk to Auguste {{Chat option|2Okay.}}}}.

===In flight===
If you accidentally crash during the balloon flight, bring 10 more logs and talk to [[Auguste]] on Entrana to try again.

====Screen one====
{{Checklist|
*Drop a sandbag.
*Burn a log.
*Relax 9 times.
*Pull the {{Colour|Red|'''red'''}} rope.
*Relax 2 times.
*Pull the {{Colour|#8f712b|'''brown'''}} rope.
*Relax 5 times.
}}

====Screen two====
{{Checklist|
*Burn a log.
*Relax.
*Burn a log.
*Relax 10 times.
*Burn a log.
*Relax 5 times.
}}

====Screen three====
{{Checklist|
*Relax 7 times.
*Pull the {{Colour|Red|'''red'''}} rope.
*Pull the {{Colour|#8f712b|'''brown'''}} rope.
*Relax 3 times.
*Burn a log.
*Relax 4 times.
*Pull the {{Colour|#8f712b|'''brown'''}} rope.}}

===Finishing up===
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[Auguste]].
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
